metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.edge_rule: Every material edge has declared type/source/target.
semantics.interface_rule: Exposes_to/sends_to/reads_from/writes_to edges correspond to exact interface/resource semantics.
semantics.dependency_rule: Dependency and topology edges remain distinct but consistent.
semantics.deployment_rule: Placed_on/environment bindings do not redefine semantic ownership.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.
